acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Midnight Corporate style When UI elements Then gold accents on dark, refined buttons, subtle borders

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Midnight Corporate UI When functional Then includes executive dashboard, KPI cards, professional chat
